A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method for the determination of effective beams, and we have used this method to characterize the in-flight beams.
the LFI beams have been characterized in terms of the effective beam, the effective beam window function and the sidelobe contamination.
we have developed a complete set of beam window functions, with associated uncertainties, which can be applied to any sky model to predict the expected signal at the Planck focal plane.
